mapper.insert: INSERT INTO match_center.profile_visit ( biz_id, from_user_id, target_user_id, visit_count, first_visited_at, last_visited_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{bizId}, #{fromUserId}, #{targetUserId}, 1, #{visitedAt}, #{visitedAt}, #{visitedAt}, #{visitedAt}, 0 ) ON CONFLICT (from_user_id, target_user_id) DO UPDATE SET visit_count = match_center.profile_visit.visit_count + 1, last_visited_at = EXCLUDED.last_visited_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
